text:
Amy Nguyen: Nightly bench-aggregate job failed again this morning, same spot as yesterday. CI shows S3 list throttling hitting the collect-metrics stage.
ci-bot: nightly/bench-aggregate • FAILED • exit 124
ci-bot: ```
2026-03-17T07:12:03Z ERROR collect-metrics: botocore.exceptions.ClientError: An error occurred (Throttling) when calling the ListObjectsV2 operation: Rate exceeded
2026-03-17T07:12:03Z INFO Retrying attempt 5/5
2026-03-17T07:12:04Z ERROR collect-metrics: stage timed out after 300s
``` 
Raj Patel: Ugh, same pattern. We either need to add exponential backoff in the list loop or switch the job to use the aggregated index in s3://redwood-aggregates/ instead of listing prefixes repeatedly.
Samir Khan: There's also a flaky test in the suite: bench/throughput_test.py::test_aggregation_latency keeps failing under load. Might be exposing the same hot-listing behavior.
Raj Patel: Quick triage plan: 1) rerun the cron with --use-cache to avoid hitting S3; 2) if rerun still fails, bisect commits from last-green..HEAD for that job; 3) open a tiny PR to add backoff wrapper and short-circuit when we see >N prefixes.
Maya Ortiz: I can kick a rerun with cache now. Using: `./infra/ci/trigger_job.sh --job bench-aggregate --env prod --tag nightly --opt use_cache=true` — kicking it.
ops-bot: Alert: S3 API errors increased in us-west-2 between 07:00-07:15 UTC. Throttling rate above baseline (link: https://internal.ops/redwood/alerts/4781)
Samir Khan: If the rerun passes with cache, we should still harden the collector. I can try a local repro with a mocked S3 that returns 429 on lists and run the flaky test under stress.
Chris Lee: Quick patch idea: wrap list_objects_v2 calls with a retry util and jitter. Something like:
```
for attempt in range(5):
    try:
        resp = client.list_objects_v2(...)
        break
    except Throttling:
        sleep( backoff( attempt ) )
        continue
```
I'll prototype a one-file change and ping for a 10-min review.
Amy Nguyen: Good. @Raj can you own the bisect if the rerun fails? Samir + Chris can pair on the patch.
Raj Patel: Yep, I can run the bisect tomorrow morning if it's still red. Please leave a note with the exact failing test name and the last-green commit range.
Maya Ortiz: Rerun report: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/bench-aggregate/1957771234-rerun — it finished, collect-metrics completed using cache and the overall job is GREEN :tada!
Amy Nguyen: Awesome, thanks Maya. Let's still do follow-up: Chris, open the tiny retry PR; Samir, try to reproduce the flaky test locally and add a stress-case to the flaky-tests board if you can reproduce.
Samir Khan: Will do. I'll add the reproduction steps to the flaky-tests board and start the mock S3 run.
Chris Lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/872 — small retry util + docs. Marked for quick review.
Maya Ortiz: I'll close the immediate incident and add a follow-up task to the eng-ml backlog to switch the job to index reads next quarter.
Amy Nguyen: Filing a follow-up ticket now and assigning owners. Thanks everyone.
ci-bot: Note: rerun used cache parameter, job bypassed repeated listing. Keep an eye on next few nights.
ops-bot: Follow-up: S3 API rates normalized at 07:25 UTC. Monitoring will continue for 24h
